name: Ashad, the Lone Cyberman
oracle_text:
The first nonlegendary artifact spell you cast each turn has casualty 2. (As you cast it, you may sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater. When you do, copy it. A copy of an artifact spell becomes a token.)
Whenever you sacrifice another creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Ashad.
blocked_sentences: The first nonlegendary artifact spell you cast each turn has casualty 2. (As you cast it, you may sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater. When you do, copy it. A copy of an artifact spell becomes a token.)

needs.what: a static ability on a permanent that grants casualty N to other spells you cast matching a spell filter (here: nonlegendary artifact spells), limited to the first matching spell each turn -- i.e. offers the optional 'sacrifice a creature with power N or greater' additional cost on that spell's cast and, when paid, copies the spell (a permanent spell's copy becoming a token)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Casualty exists only as a card's own `additional_cost` + `additional_optional` read back through `additional_paid` and `copy_spell`; no static grants an additional cost to other spells. `cast_gains_keywords` grants only ability keywords on a free-cast permission, `granted_alternative_cost` is an alternative (not additional) cost, and casualty is not in `keywords`. There is also no static per-turn 'first matching spell' limiter on such a grant
